name: Mountains Washed Into Paintings
take: The Energy Regen payoff. Feed the Outro a full 600 Floral Epistle and the first Plume Step arms everyone in the Landscape: consuming Negative Status or Electro Rage stacks converts every 0.12% of her Energy Regen above 200% into 0.1% ATK — up to a full 50% team-wide. Her double ER-main echo build stops being plumbing and becomes the payload. Reflecting Shadow off the third Plume Step lasts twice as long, and her Drizzle Stance strings become uninterruptible.

name: Clouds Pour Like Molten Gold
take: THE Bane-crew node. Everyone inside the Ceaseless Landscape gains 50% Crit DMG for 30s after inflicting any Negative Status or dealing its DMG — Frazzle and Burst and Chafe and Erosion and Flare all count, and so does consuming Havoc Bane stacks. That is half a Crit DMG stat stick handed to the exact crew she was hired to support. Step outside the field and the faucet shuts off — the Landscape is the contract.

name: Sparse Curtains Invite Evening Glow
take: Rotation grease with a knife hidden in it. Casting Drizzle Stance grants Kingfisher — press basic right after and she skips straight to Stage 4 of the string, cashing Kingfisher in for 20 Concerto Energy and 350 Floral Epistle on the spot. That is over half the Outro's 600-point bank from one button press every 25s. The support who used to farm her resource now just... has it.

name: Autumn Mountains in Choir Sing
take: The healing amp. Enrichment and Spring's Birth heal for 50% more — the passive drip that quietly tops the crew between buffs now overfills them. Nothing flashy, no new mechanic. Just the floor of the entire kit raised by half.

name: I Long To Ride The Eastern Wind
take: The selfish node. Basic and Heavy Attack in Drizzle Stance get their DMG Multipliers doubled. She spends the whole rotation in that stance banking Floral Epistle anyway — now the banking itself hits. The healer starts showing up on the damage chart out of spite.

name: Staying True To This Splendid Realm
take: The finale is a single obscene number: Tinkling Jade and Awakening Spring gain 500% Crit DMG. The intro that already rides in with 80% Crit Rate and a 240% Glacio DMG bonus becomes a once-per-rotation screenshot machine. The kit codex called that intro the secret nuke — at S6 the secret is out.
